en.headline: Seven arrested over Tsim Sha Tsui bar assault that left man in critical condition
en.dek: Police say the 32-year-old victim suffered severe head injuries and a fractured rib; some of those arrested are suspected of having triad links and further arrests are not ruled out.
body: Police arrested seven people on Wednesday in connection with an assault at an upstairs bar in Tsim Sha Tsui that left a 32-year-old man in critical condition.

The incident occurred in the early hours of Sunday at a bar on Cameron Road. Officers said they suspect the victim and his companions’ behaviour caused dissatisfaction among people sitting nearby, leading to a physical confrontation that may have been aggravated by alcohol.

Superintendent Ching Chi-yan of Crime Kowloon West Headquarters said the arrestees, aged 24 to 46, are alleged to have committed wounding with intent and assisting offenders. Around seven to eight people are suspected of taking part in the attack, while five to six others allegedly helped the attackers flee, provided places for them to hide, and assisted them in evading police. Some of those involved are suspected of having a triad background.

The victim sustained severe head injuries and a fractured left rib. He underwent two brain surgeries and remains in intensive care. Police seized clothing worn by the attackers and four vehicles used in the getaway. Authorities have not ruled out further arrests.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀酒吧傷人案七人被捕 傷者情況危殆
zh.dek: 警方指32歲男傷者頭部嚴重受傷及肋骨骨折，部分被捕人士涉嫌有黑社會背景，不排除再有人被捕。
body: 警方星期三就尖沙咀一間樓上酒吧發生的傷人案拘捕七人，一名32歲男子情況危殆。
案件於星期日凌晨在金馬倫道一間酒吧發生。警方表示，懷疑傷者及其友伴的行為引起鄰座人士不滿，其後發生肢體衝突，酒精可能加劇了事件。
西九龍總區刑事總部警司程志仁表示，被捕人士年齡介乎24至46歲，涉嫌意圖傷人及協助罪犯。約七至八人涉嫌參與襲擊，另有五至六人涉嫌協助襲擊者逃走、提供藏匿地方及協助他們逃避警方追捕。部分涉案人士涉嫌有黑社會背景。
傷者頭部嚴重受傷及左肋骨骨折，曾接受兩次腦部手術，現仍留醫深切治療部。警方檢獲襲擊者當時所穿衣物及四輛用作逃走的車輛，不排除再有人被捕。
